en.headline: Caritas holds charity bazaars in Mong Kok and Cheung Chau today
en.dek: The annual fundraising events run from 10am to 6pm at Fa Hui Park and until 5:30pm at Pak Tai Temple Playground under the Messengers of Hope theme.
body: Caritas Hong Kong is holding its annual charity bazaars today at two locations as part of a series running over four Sundays. The Kowloon event takes place at Fa Hui Park in Mong Kok from 10am to 6pm, while the Cheung Chau bazaar is at Pak Tai Temple Playground from 10am to 5:30pm.

The organisers said this year’s theme is “Messengers of Hope” to mark the 80th anniversary of the Catholic Diocese of Hong Kong. Stalls offer goods and gifts, with stage performances and other activities. The first two bazaars last Sunday at Victoria Park and Tuen Mun drew more than 23,000 visitors.
Proceeds support Caritas’s social work, education and medical services. The remaining bazaars are scheduled for Tsuen Wan on 22 November and Sheung Shui on 29 November.

zh.headline: 明愛慈善賣物會今日在旺角花墟及長洲舉行
zh.dek: 年度籌款活動在花墟公園上午10時至下午6時舉行，長洲北帝廟遊樂場至下午5時30分，主題為希望的傳承者。
body: 香港明愛今日在兩個地點舉行年度慈善賣物會，屬連續四個星期日系列之一。九龍區活動在旺角花墟公園上午10時至下午6時舉行，長洲區則在北帝廟遊樂場上午10時至下午5時30分舉行。
主辦單位表示，今年主題為「希望的傳承者」，以紀念天主教香港教區成立八十週年。場地設有各類商品及禮品摊位，並有舞台表演及其他活動。上星期日在維多利亞公園及屯門的首兩場賣物會吸引超過2.3萬人次參與。
所得收益支持明愛的社會服務、教育及醫療工作。其餘賣物會定於11月22日在荃灣及29日在上水舉行。
